trial_title: Study Comparing Bioequivalence of Two New Formulations of Premarin/MPA With Premarin/MPA Reference Formulation.
brief_summary:
This study will compare the bioequivalence of two new investigational combination formulations of Premarin and medroxyprogesterone acetate (MPA) with a currently marketed formulation of Premarin and medroxyprogesterone, Prempro™.

Prempro is indicated for use after menopause in women with a uterus to reduce moderate to severe hot flashes; to treat moderate to severe dryness, itching, and burning, in and around the vagina; and to help reduce your chances of getting osteoporosis (thin weak bones).

eligibility_table.criterion: Healthy, postmenopausal women ages 35 to 70 years, inclusive.
Healthy, postmenopausal women ages 35 to 70 years, inclusive.

Naturally postmenopausal women must not have had a menstrual period for at least six months, but less than 12 months, as confirmed by a blood test; or for at least 12 months with no blood hormone test confirmation. Naturally postmenopausal women must not have had a menstrual period since the age of 54.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not had a menstrual period for 10 weeks, which does not meet the requirement of at least 6 months without a period for naturally postmenopausal women.

eligibility_table.criterion: Surgically menopausal women must have undergone bilateral oophorectomy (removal of both ovaries) at least 5 months prior to the start of the study, and the surgical report may be requested to confirm the surgery date and that the surgery was not due to a cancerous condition.
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided regarding whether the patient has undergone a bilateral oophorectomy, making it indeterminate.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone bilateral oophorectomy at least 5 months prior to the start of the study?

eligibility_table.criterion: Nonsmoker or smoker of fewer than 10 cigarettes per day as determined by history. Must be able to abstain from smoking during the inpatient stay.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient’s smoking status is not mentioned, so it cannot be determined if she meets the smoking criteria.
